name: butyrospermum parkii (shea) butter + melaleuca alternifolia (tea tree) leaf oil + simmondsia chinensis (jojoba) seed oil
purpose: 1. Helps soften thick, rough, and hardened skin. 2. Gently exfoliates dry, flaky, and uneven texture. 3. Helps improve the appearance of cracked heels and calluses. 4. Moisturizes deeply to leave skin feeling smoother and softer. 5. With salicylic acid, lactic acid, and ceramides to support smoother-looking skin.
uses: Use on feet, heels, elbows, knees, or other rough areas. Wash hands after use.
otcwarn: Do not use on broken, irritated, or sensitive skin. Do not use on broken, irritated, or sensitive skin.
